name: Black Marsh Spider Venom

ABOUT

This potent spider venom causes victims to become disoriented and lose muscle control until eventually they collapse.

DETAILS

Type poison (injury); Save Fort DC 14; Onset —; Frequency 1/rd. for 6 rds.; Cure 2 consecutive saves.

EFFECT

1d4 Dex and confused for 1 round.
